item.title: Seed Gap - Collaborative Knowledge Base Governance
item.description: Seed Gap: Collaborative Knowledge Base Governance The Gap The Seed provides extensive rules for individual/personal knowledge bases but lacks explicit guidance for collaborative or multi-author knowledge bases — vaults where multiple people contribute, review, or access different subsets of content.
